doc.summary: Adds a simple rule that only matches the given <ref cls="net/minecraft/resources/Identifier">Identifier</ref>.
doc.text: Adds a simple rule that only matches the given Identifier. When this rule matches it will return the value of allow as result.

Parses a simple rule. This allows for a Identifier string where asterisks (*) can match any amount of characters in the Identifier. However an asterisk can never match a colon.
The special case '*' matches every Identifier. By default this will return the allow list state of the resource list as result.
To change this prepend a plus (+) to make it return true or a minus (-) to make it return false on a match.
